HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "voice")
MODEL = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "models", "ggml-base.en.bin")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

NUMBERS = {"16": "sixteen", "2": "two", "1": "one", "5": "five"}


def spoken(text):
    """Text as the voice should read it (pronunciation hints only)."""
    t = text.replace("npm test", "n p m test").replace("Next.js", "Next J S")
    t = t.replace("README", "read me").replace("API keys", "A P I keys")
    t = re.sub(r"\bID\b", "I D", t)
    t = t.replace("...", ",")
    return t


def letters(text):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())
    words = [NUMBERS.get(w, w) for w in words]
    return "".join(words)


def transcribe(wav):
    out = subprocess.run(["whisper-cli", "-m", MODEL, "-f", wav, "-np", "-nt", "-l", "en"],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return " ".join(out.split())


def sentences(body):
    parts = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", body.strip())
    merged = []
    for p in parts:
        if merged and merged[-1].endswith("..."):
            merged[-1] = merged[-1] + " " + p
        else:
            merged.append(p)
    return merged


md = open(os.path.join(APP, "demo-video", "narration-script.md")).read()
sections = re.findall(r"^## (\d+)\. (.+?)\n(.+?)(?=\n## |\Z)", md, re.S | re.M)
manifest, failures = [], []
for n, title, body in sections:
    lines = []
    for k, text in enumerate(sentences(body)):
        best = None
        for attempt in range(1, 7):
            base = os.path.join(OUT, f"s{int(n):02d}_{k:02d}")
            subprocess.run(["say", "-v", "Aman", "-r", "170", "-o", base + ".aiff", spoken(text)], check=True)
            subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", base + ".aiff", "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1", base + ".wav"], check=True)
            heard = transcribe(base + ".wav")
            score = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, letters(text), letters(heard)).ratio()
            if best is None or score > best["score"]:
                os.replace(base + ".aiff", base + ".best.aiff")
                best = {"text": text, "heard": heard, "score": round(score, 3), "attempts": attempt}
            if score >= 0.9:
                break
        dur = float(subprocess.check_output(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
                                             "-of", "csv=p=0", base + ".best.aiff"]))
        best.update(file=base + ".best.aiff", duration=round(dur, 3))
        lines.append(best)
        flag = "OK " if best["score"] >= 0.9 else "LOW"
        if flag == "LOW":
            failures.append((n, k, best))
        print(f"{flag} [{n}.{k}] {best['score']:.2f} x{best['attempts']}  {text}  ->  {best['heard']}", flush=True)
    manifest.append({"section": int(n), "title": title, "lines": lines})

json.dump(manifest, open(os.path.join(OUT, "manifest.json"), "w"), indent=1)
total = sum(l["duration"] for s in manifest for l in s["lines"])
print(f"\nsentences: {sum(len(s['lines']) for s in manifest)}, speech: {total:.0f}s, below 0.90: {len(failures)}")

"""Checks the recorded video: (1) every narration sentence is understood by
whisper at its timeline position; (2) no loading/blank screen is on screen
while a sentence is spoken."""
import difflib, json, os, re, subprocess

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
V = os.path.join(HERE, "out2", "fleet-workspace-demo.mp4")
M = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(HERE), "models", "ggml-base.en.bin")
W = os.path.join(HERE, "verify-tmp")
os.makedirs(W, exist_ok=True)
NUM = {"16": "sixteen", "2": "two", "1": "one", "2nd": "second"}


def letters(t):
    return "".join(NUM.get(w, w) for w in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", t.lower()))


def frame_stats(t):
    raw = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-ss", f"{t:.2f}", "-i", V, "-frames:v", "1",
                          "-vf", "scale=128:80,format=gray", "-f", "rawvideo", "-"], capture_output=True).stdout
    n = len(raw); m = sum(raw) / n
    return m, (sum((b - m) ** 2 for b in raw) / n) ** 0.5


tl = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "out2", "timeline.json")))
low, scores, loading = [], [], []
for i, l in enumerate(tl):
    f = os.path.join(W, f"w{i:03d}.wav")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", str(max(0, l["at"] - 0.3)), "-t", str(l["duration"] + 0.45),
                    "-i", V, "-vn", "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1", f], check=True)
    heard = " ".join(subprocess.run(["whisper-cli", "-m", M, "-f", f, "-np", "-nt", "-l", "en"],
                                    capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split())
    sc = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, letters(l["text"]), letters(heard)).ratio()
    scores.append(sc)
    if sc < 0.9:
        low.append((i, round(sc, 2), l["at"], l["text"], heard))
    if l["segment"] == "edge1_url_missing":
        continue  # the not-found page is a mostly empty card by design
    for frac in (0.05, 0.5, 0.95):
        t = l["at"] + l["duration"] * frac
        m, sd = frame_stats(t)
        if sd < 12 and m > 150:
            loading.append((round(t, 1), l["segment"], l["text"][:50]))

dur = float(subprocess.check_output(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", V]))
print(f"LENGTH: {dur:.1f}s ({int(dur // 60)} min {int(dur % 60)} s)")
print(f"CLARITY: {len(tl)} sentences, average {sum(scores) / len(scores):.3f}, below 0.90: {len(low)}")
for x in low:
    print("  ", x)
print(f"LOADING/BLANK under narration: {len(loading)}")
for x in loading:
    print("  ", x)
